artworks.title: The Polish Rider
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and gray wash over red chalk on blue paper, laid down
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated on a horse, turned towards the left and holding a spear with a flag. The man has a mustache and wears traditional clothing. He has a quiver on his back and carries a shield. The horse is mid-stride with decorative gear. The background shows a cloudy sky and a plain landscape.

artworks.title: Fantasy of Magnificent Courtyards and Loggie with a Monumental Staircase
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray and black wash over graphite on two joined pieces of laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural interior featuring a grand staircase. The image depicts a detailed view of a setting with columns, archways, and a central staircase. Classical elements such as moldings, sculptures, and cornices are present. The arches have sculptural details and depth, indicating a vast interior space. The staircase perspective conveys grandeur and opulence.

artworks.title: The Cloisters, Tintern Abbey
artworks.medium: salted paper print
artworks.description: This grayscale photograph shows a group of individuals in front of an old stone structure with ornate archways and windows. Some people are sitting and others standing. Two women in dresses, cloaks, and bonnets are seated on a ledge, one of them holding an open book. A man with a top hat stands next them, and another man in a coat and bow tie stands by a gate in the background. A child stands to the left, leaning against a stone arch and facing us, wearing a dark, long-sleeved dress. Vegetation covers parts of the stone wall near the upper-right corner. The background features the grassy ground and the elaborate stone architecture of the building, including arches, windows, and decorative stonework.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Boy
artworks.artist: Albert Sands Southworth and Josiah Johnson Hawes
artworks.medium: daguerreotype
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a young person standing with a relaxed posture, leaning against a wooden railing. They have one hand resting on the railing and the other hand holding a cap. The person has a youthful appearance, with short, neatly parted hair and is wearing a formal outfit with a dark-colored jacket, high-collared shirt, tie, and waistcoat. The background is neutral, and the edges are slightly blurred, contained within an oval frame.

artworks.title: Cloud Study, Roman Campagna
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.description: The image shows a vast landscape with a dramatic sky. The horizon is low in the composition, emphasizing the sky and clouds. Rolling hills and a solitary tree are visible on the horizon. The sky has varied cloud densities, from dark on the left to light on the right. The color palette is sepia-toned, giving the image a vintage look. Textures and contrasts between the clouds and sky are highlighted, enhancing the nostalgic atmosphere.

artworks.title: Miss Raymond
artworks.medium: pastel on cream laid paper, mounted to canvas (on stretcher)
artworks.creditLine: Ellen F. Karpf and New Century Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman's upper body. She is looking into the distance with her head turned slightly to the left. She has light skin, pink lips, and a calm expression. Her hair is styled in an updo with soft curls framing her face and a veil draped over it. She is wearing a light-colored garment with lace detailing around the neckline and is resting a hand on her chest. The background has a subtle gradient of blue and green hues. A signature and date are visible to the left of her shoulder.

artworks.title: Interior of an Ancient Roman Sepulchre
artworks.medium: lithograph in gray and black on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a subterranean Roman architectural space. The drawing showcases a vaulted underground chamber with classical architectural elements such as columns, arches, and brickwork. In the center, there is a pyramid-like tomb adorned with decorative sculptures and reliefs. The detailing includes carvings of figures and motifs. Light enters from an unseen opening, creating shadows and highlighting the stone textures. The scene depicts a grand and ancient vault, reminiscent of classical Roman designs.

artworks.title: Coat of Arms with a Single Eagle
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 21 x 17 cm (8 1/4 x 6 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a double-headed eagle with a heraldic shield. The image features a double-headed eagle with detailed feathers. Each head faces opposite directions. The wings are widespread, with intricate detailing on each feather. At the center of the eagle's body is a heraldic shield, divided into sections with different patterns. The talons of the eagle are prominently drawn. The image is monochromatic, with sharp contrasts creating depth and emphasis on the lines and contours. The style is reminiscent of early European heraldic art.

artworks.title: John Temple
artworks.medium: pastel on tan laid paper mounted on canvas (on strainer)
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man, focusing on his head and shoulders. He is positioned slightly to the side, with his body angled but his face turned towards the viewer. The man has light, possibly powdered, hair styled neatly and slightly curled back. His facial features are strong and refined, with a fair complexion, blue eyes, and a slight smile. He is wearing a formal, dark brown coat with a standing collar and decorative trim, over a white shirt or cravat and a blue waistcoat. Large buttons are visible on the coat. The background is a muted, dark brown. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held.

artworks.title: Joshua, King David and Judas Maccabeus
artworks.artist: Primary Master of the Strassburg Chronicle
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over traces of black chalk on on laid paper ruled in leadpoint
artworks.description: The image depicts three full-length figures in suits of armor. The central figure has long hair and a decorative headpiece, while the others have facial hair and ornate helmets. Each figure holds a sword and shield with unique designs. The foreground shows a patterned floor, and beneath the figures is handwritten text. The background is plain.

artworks.title: King Arthur, Charlemagne and Godfrey of Boulogne
artworks.artist: Primary Master of the Strassburg Chronicle
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over traces of black chalk on on laid paper ruled in leadpoint
artworks.description: The image shows three full-body figures in a standing position. In the center is a bearded man with a crown adorned with intricate details and leaves, wearing detailed armor. To his right is a woman wearing a crown, with long wavy hair flowing from beneath it. She holds a sword in one hand and a shield with a crowned heart and cross in the other. To the left stands another armored figure with a helmet with a plume, holding a sword and a shield with a cross pattern. Each individual is distinct in their medieval-style armor, and they all hold swords upright, resting on the ground. The background features a tiled floor with a repetitive pattern, and there are inscriptions in stylized script at the top and bottom of the image.

artworks.title: A Boxer
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper mounted on 18th century album sheet
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a dog's head facing forward. The dog's features are detailed, including eyes, a snout, and ears. The sketch depicts the texture of the fur around the dog's face and neck. The background is plain. No additional elements are present in the image.

artworks.title: An Episcopal Visitation
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene within a grand architectural setting. The drawing shows a group of individuals gathered in a large, vaulted space. There are columns with ornate capitals in the foreground and intricate archways in the background. The space is illuminated, casting shadows and emphasizing the height and depth of the architecture. The focus is on a group of people with one person in ceremonial attire standing before them, creating a scene rich with fabric textures and interplay of light and shadow on the stone surfaces. The rendering shows attention to architectural features, capturing the solemnity and grandness of the space.

artworks.title: The Betrothal of the Virgin
artworks.medium: woodcut on blue laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed irregularly to block): 29.9 × 21.1 cm (11 3/4 × 8 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people standing in the center of an ornate architectural setting. An elderly man with a long beard and a significant hat is holding the hands of a man and a woman. The man on the left is wearing a robe and a head covering, facing the woman on the right who is slightly bent forward and wearing a detailed gown with a headpiece. Other people in robes and various headdresses surround them, observing attentively. The background features an elaborate arched structure with intricate carvings and columns, creating a grand and solemn ambiance.

artworks.title: Still Life with a Skull and a Vase of Roses
artworks.artist: Jean Morin, after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 38.1 x 31.3 cm (15 x 12 5/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David and Elizabeth Tunick
artworks.description: This print features a large human skull in the center, with an open container adorned with intricate patterns to the left and a clear glass vase containing two roses to the right. The container on the left is open, the lid flipped up, with a line on the face similar to a compass. The objects are positioned on a flat surface with wood grain, and the wall behind them is black. Below the print are two lines of text.

artworks.title: Étude d'après Nature [nude study]
artworks.medium: salted paper print

artworks.title: Forest Scene
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.description: The image shows a path through a dense forest. Tall trees with sparse foliage cast elongated silhouettes on the ground. Light filters through the canopy, creating a dappled effect on the path. A solitary figure stands on the path, adding scale to the trees. The scene is in black and white, emphasizing light and shadow. The atmosphere is calm and slightly mysterious.

artworks.title: The Pearl Necklace
artworks.medium: wood engraving on tissue paper mounted on heavyweight paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Eric Denker in honor of Lynn P. Russell, Curator of Education
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman in a side profile, standing and slightly bending forward. She has her hair styled back in a bun with a ribbon tied around it. She is wearing a light-colored, patterned garment with loose sleeves, and adjusting a pearl necklace around her neck. In the background, there is a table covered with a decorative cloth on which various indistinct objects rest. The setting is minimal, with an empty wall behind her, emphasizing her figure and the act of adorning herself with the necklace.

artworks.title: The Pearl Necklace
artworks.medium: wood engraving on calendered paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Eric Denker in honor of Lynn P. Russell, Curator of Education
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing in front of a table. She is in profile, with her face turned slightly to the right. She has a bow in her hair and is wearing a patterned garment with wide sleeves. She is holding a string of beads. On the table, there is a small bowl and a piece of fabric. The background is an unadorned wall.

artworks.title: An Alpine Valley with Trees and Boulders
artworks.medium: watercolor, gouache and black chalk, with pen and black ink, over traces of graphite on  wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Helen Porter and James T. Dyke

artworks.title: A Woman in Profile and a Pollard Tree in Bloom
artworks.medium: conte crayon with stumping on brown paper
artworks.description: The image shows a side profile portrait of a person, capturing their upper body and head. The individual is positioned in profile, facing left. They have distinct facial features with a prominent nose and a defined jawline. Their hair is styled in curls and pulled back neatly. The person is dressed in what appears to be period clothing, with a high-collared shirt that has some detailing. They are wearing a single earring, which is visible on the ear facing the viewer. The background consists of a detailed sketch of trees with branches and leaves, adding a textured element to the composition. The image has an overall classic, drawn appearance with elements annotated, including dates and text on the piece.

artworks.title: Old Man with a Helmet
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man from the waist up, seated slightly to the side but facing forward. His facial features are prominent with deep-set eyes, a furrowed brow, and a long, full beard. His hair is curly and voluminous. He is dressed in a thick fur-like garment that envelops his shoulders and chest. In his right hand, he holds a piece of fabric or hat with a decorative band. There is a strap across his chest with a round buckle. The background is dark and textured.

artworks.title: Saint Wenzel Cooking Hosts as Two Youths Press Wine
artworks.medium: black chalk with blue and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval kitchen scene with figures engaged in various culinary tasks. The image depicts a room with stone walls and a checkered floor, serving as the setting for a busy kitchen. Shelves hold jars and sacks, while barrels are stacked against the wall. On the left, a figure in flowing robes sits on a stool, using a pair of tongs to handle round objects on a cylindrical cooking stove. The central figure stands at a large wooden contraption, possibly a press, while another figure on the right kneels beside a set of barrels, attending to a container. The scene captures the activity and tools typical of a historical kitchen.

artworks.title: Wooded Cliffs along a Riverbank
artworks.medium: watercolor over black chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a winding stream. The horizon is in the middle distance where the land meets the sky. On the rocky terrain, trees spread out, while an arch bridge is visible to the right. The colors are muted, with shades of gray, green, and brown dominating the palette.
